controls.title: Adobe events use the enterprise analytics adapter
controls.rationale: One adapter centralizes consent handling, shared XDM fields, datastream selection, and error reporting.
controls.remediation: Replace direct alloy('sendEvent') calls with the approved analytics.track adapter.

controls.title: Analytics events use the canonical taxonomy
controls.rationale: Stable domain.object.action names keep Adobe Analytics dimensions and downstream reporting comparable across applications.
controls.remediation: Use a registered lowercase domain.object.action event name, such as commerce.checkout.started.

verification.description: Run adobe-analytics-eslint/require-canonical-event-name and compare new names with the analytics taxonomy registry.

controls.title: Analytics payloads exclude direct identifiers
controls.rationale: Behavioral analytics events must not carry direct identifiers when pseudonymous or aggregate attributes satisfy the reporting purpose.
controls.remediation: Remove direct identifiers and use approved pseudonymous identity and consent mechanisms.

verification.description: Run adobe-analytics-eslint/no-direct-identifiers and complete privacy review for new payload fields.

controls.exceptionPolicy: Privacy approval with a documented purpose, retention period, and removal date.
